paper_title: A physics-informed deep neural network for surrogate modeling in classical elasto-plasticity
evidence_summary: Atlas paper 539 states that the synthetic training dataset can be found at the exact meghbali/ANNElastoplasticity repository and that the PyTorch neural-network code developed for the study is accessible at the same repository, including the EPNN architecture.
